# South Dakota Codified Laws from sdlegislature.gov's own Statutes API: the title list (/api/Statutes/Title), then each whole title as one HTML (/api/Statutes/<title>.html?all=true); each section is its own <html> document in it, whose first paragraph is "<number>. <catchline>".
import re

API = 'https://sdlegislature.gov/api/Statutes/'
STUB = re.compile(r'^(\d+[A-Z]?-\d+[A-Z]?-\d+(?:\.\d+)*[A-Z]?) (\d+[A-Z]?-\d+[A-Z]?-\d+(?:\.\d+)*[A-Z]?)((?:,| to) [^.]+)?\.\s*(.+)$')
HEAD = re.compile(r'^(\d+[A-Z]?-\d+[A-Z]?-\d+(?:\.\d+)*[A-Z]?)\s*\.?\s*(.*)$')

def sections():
    titles = [t['Statute'] for t in fetch_json(API + 'Title') if t.get('Type') == 'Title']
    log('titles: %d' % len(titles))
    seen = set()
    for t in titles:
        url = API + t + '.html?all=true'
        try:
            kind, body = fetch(url)
        except Exception as e:
            log('title %s failed: %s' % (t, e)); continue
        if isinstance(body, bytes):
            body = body.decode('utf-16' if body[:2] in (b'\xff\xfe', b'\xfe\xff') else 'utf-8', 'ignore')
        if '\x00' in body[:200]:          # the API sends utf-16le with no byte-order mark; the fetcher read it as cp1252
            body = body.encode('cp1252', 'replace').decode('utf-16-le', 'replace')
        n, stubs = 0, {}
        for doc in body.split('<hr>'):
            lines = [' '.join(p.split()) for p in block_texts(doc, attr=('dir', 'ltr'))]   # one line per paragraph; some titles are pretty-printed
            lines = [l for l in lines if l]
            m = HEAD.match(lines[0]) if lines else None
            if not m:                         # a chapter's table of contents ("CHAPTER 1-1"): a repealed or transferred
                for l in lines:               # section has no document of its own, only "1-1-11 1-1-11. Repealed by SL 2006, ch 130, § 1."
                    s = STUB.match(l)
                    if s and s.group(1) == s.group(2):        # "1-6-24 1-6-24 to 1-6-28. Repealed ..." lands on its first number
                        stubs.setdefault(s.group(1), l[len(s.group(1)) + 1:] if s.group(3) else s.group(4).strip())
                continue
            if m.group(1) in seen:
                continue
            sid, heading = m.group(1), m.group(2).strip()
            text = '\n'.join(lines[1:]).strip() or heading   # "Repealed by SL 2001, ch 1, § 2." is the whole section
            seen.add(sid); n += 1
            yield {'id': sid, 'heading': heading.rstrip('.').strip() or sid, 'text': text,
                   'url': 'https://sdlegislature.gov/Statutes/' + sid}
        for sid, note in stubs.items():
            if sid not in seen:
                seen.add(sid); n += 1
                yield {'id': sid, 'heading': note.rstrip('.').strip()[:240], 'text': note, 'url': 'https://sdlegislature.gov/Statutes/' + sid}
        log('title %s: %d sections' % (t, n))
